extDescription.message: Guildswarm Hangar Manager Extension offers you a tool to download all information of your RSI hangar in one file with just one click
extDescription.description: Descripción de la extensión en la tienda

buttonExportHangar.description: Texto del botón de la extensión en la página de pledges de RSI

stepFileSync.message: Saving your hangar for SC Tools

syncNoteHelp.message: Your hangar is saved for SC Tools instead of downloaded. To download the file, turn off Auto Sync in SC Tools.

errorSaveHangar.message: Could not save your hangar for SC Tools, so the file was downloaded instead. $p1$

errorsHelpParagraph1.message: Sometimes, when requesting information from the RSI website, errors can prevent us from getting the data of a whole page. When that happens, the extension tries to recover the information item by item for that page. If this fallback also fails, the item cannot be included in the file because its data is not available.

errorsHelpParagraph2.message: We are sorry for any inconvenience this may cause. These errors come from restrictions on the RSI website and, although we do our best to minimize their impact, sometimes the information of some items cannot be recovered.

errorHangarPage.message: Error while reading page $p1$ of the hangar. $p2$

errorHangarElement.message: Error while reading items one by one (page $p1$, item $p2$), the data of this item will not be in the generated file. $p3$

errorBuyBackPage.message: Error while reading page $p1$ of the buyback. $p2$

errorBuyBackElement.message: Error while reading items one by one (page $p1$, item $p2$), the data of this item will not be in the generated file. $p3$

errorRestoreCurrency.message: Could not restore your RSI store currency ($p1$). You can change it back in the store itself. $p2$
errorRestoreCurrency.description: $1 = moneda de la tienda, $2 = detalle del error

errorNoServiceWorkerResponse.message: No response from the Service Worker. Message.type:$p1$

errorRsiTokenCookie.message: Could not get the Rsi-Token cookie.

errorRsiAuthToken.message: Could not get the RSI auth token.

errorAuthToken.message: Could not get the auth token.

errorUnknown.message: Unknown error while getting the hangar data.
